new_standard.title: Electroacoustics — Sound Level Meters: Part 1 Specifications
new_standard.scope: Specifies electrical and electroacoustic performance requirements for Class 1 (precision) and Class 2 (general field use) sound level meters used in ambient, industrial, and environmental noise monitoring.
new_standard.materials: Precision half-inch free-field condenser microphone, acoustic preamplifier, digital signal processor, LCD display with A, C, and Z frequency weightings.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Frequency weighting curves (A, C, Z), time weightings (Fast 125 ms, Slow 1000 ms, Peak), linear operating range (min 60 dB), dynamic range (30 dBA to 140 dBA), directional response tolerances, environmental stability (-10°C to 50°C).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Exact legal verification of ambient noise level compliance under the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Acoustic calibration check using Class 1 acoustic calibrator (IS 15881 / IEC 60942) before and after measurement; periodic laboratory calibration per IEC 61672-3.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)

mapping.evidence_source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Environmental Noise Monitoring Protocol; Noise Pollution Rules 2000
mapping.evidence_excerpt: All environmental noise assessments submitted to State Pollution Control Boards and NGT must use sound level meters conforming to IS 15575 / IEC 61672 Class 1.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory acoustic instrumentation standard for environmental noise monitoring in India.

Acoustic Sound Level Meters.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Identical to IEC 61672-1.

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB Environmental Noise Monitoring Protocol; Noise Pollution Rules 2000
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes performance specifications for Class 1 precision sound level meters.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory specification for Class 1 precision sound level meters.

new_standard.title: Electroacoustics — Specifications for Personal Sound Exposure Meters
new_standard.scope: Specifies performance and testing requirements for body-worn personal sound exposure meters (noise dosimeters) used to evaluate occupational worker daily noise exposure dose (Lex,8h) under industrial hygiene programs.
new_standard.materials: Miniature microphone with clip, wearable body pack, digital logging microprocessor, intrinsic safety casing.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Measurement range (70 dBA to 140 dBA), frequency weighting A, exchange rate (3 dB or 5 dB per OSHA / ISO norms), noise dose percentage calculation (100% dose = 85/90 dBA over 8 hours), intrinsic safety certification for hazardous petroleum/mining atmospheres (ATEX/IECEx).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Accurate occupational deafness prevention monitoring without interfering with worker physical activities in heavy factories.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Acoustic calibration per IEC 60942, electromagnetic immunity test, intrinsic safety spark barrier verification.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / Factories Act 1948 Model Rules

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act, 1948 (Section 87 Dangerous Operations); Directorate General of Factory Advice Service (DGFASLI)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory conformity to IS 15801 / IEC 61252 for personal noise dosimeters used in industrial occupational health surveillance.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory occupational hygiene standard for personal noise exposure dosimeters.

Personal Noise Dosimeters for Industrial.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Identical to IEC 61252.

Bio-Enzyme Grease Trap and Drain Cleaner.investigation_notes: Commercial bacterial consortia and bio-enzymatic drain cleaners are proprietary biological formulations evaluated under general wastewater discharge standards of the Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986; however, no dedicated Indian Standard currently standardizes the microbial strain identification, enzymatic activity units, or shelf stability of commercial bio-enzyme cleaners in India.

new_standard.title: Standards for Treatment and Disposal of Bio-Medical Waste by Incineration — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies engineering, combustion, and emission standards for dual-chamber bio-medical waste incinerators used in common bio-medical waste treatment facilities (CBWTF).
new_standard.materials: Heavy refractory lined primary and secondary combustion chambers, automated waste feeding ram, dry/wet flue gas scrubber.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Primary chamber temperature (min 800°C +/- 50°C), secondary chamber temperature (min 1050°C +/- 50°C), flue gas retention time in secondary chamber (min 2.0 seconds), continuous online CO and O2 monitoring, emission limits (dioxins/furans max 0.1 ng TEQ/Nm3, particulate matter max 50 mg/Nm3, HCl max 50 mg/Nm3).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Complete destruction of anatomical waste, microbiological pathogens, and hazardous hospital pharmaceuticals without toxic dioxin emissions.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Flue gas continuous emission monitoring (CEMS), isokinetic particulate sampling per IS 11255 (Part 1), dioxin/furan sampling per USEPA Method 23.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 2 / CPCB Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules

mapping.evidence_source: Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016 (Schedule II Standards for Incineration); CPCB CBWTF Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory statutory compliance with dual-chamber operating temperatures and 0.1 ng TEQ/Nm3 dioxin limit for all biomedical waste incinerators in India.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory environmental engineering standard for biomedical waste incinerators.

Bio-Medical Waste Incinerators.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 2. Strictly governed under Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules 2016.

mapping.evidence_source: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016 (Schedule II); CPCB Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Common hazardous waste incinerators must maintain secondary chamber temperature >= 1100°C and conform to CPCB incineration standards.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for hazardous waste rotary kiln incinerators.

Hazardous Waste Rotary Kiln Incinerators.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 2. Governed under Hazardous Waste Management Rules 2016.

mapping.evidence_source: Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016 (Schedule II Standards for Autoclaving and Shredding)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory biological validation (Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores 10^4 reduction) and waste mutilation shredding factor.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for hospital biomedical waste autoclave-shredder systems.

new_standard.title: Plastics — Specifications for Compostable Plastics
new_standard.scope: Specifies procedures and requirements for the identification and labeling of plastics, plastic products, and packaging (including PLA forks, spoons, knives, straws, and carry bags) that are suitable for recovery through municipal and industrial composting.
new_standard.materials: Biodegradable aliphatic polyester polymers (polylactic acid PLA, polyhydroxyalkanoates PHA, polybutylene adipate terephthalate PBAT) compounded with mineral fillers.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Biodegradation requirement (min 90% organic carbon conversion to CO2 within 180 days under controlled composting conditions), disintegration requirement (max 10% residue remaining on 2 mm sieve after 84 days), ecotoxicity (germination rate and plant biomass > 90% of blank compost), strict limits on heavy metals (Pb <= 50 ppm, Cd <= 0.5 ppm, Hg <= 0.5 ppm, As <= 5 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Zero persistent microplastic accumulation in terrestrial ecosystems; safe biodegradation in commercial organic compost heaps.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Biodegradation test per ISO 14855-1, disintegration test per ISO 16929, plant phytotoxicity test per OECD 208.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards PCD 12 / CPCB Plastic Waste Management Rules

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016; CPCB Mandatory Certification
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Rule 4(h) Plastic Waste Management Rules: No manufacturer may sell compostable plastic carry bags or cutlery without valid certificate from CPCB confirming compliance with IS/ISO 17088.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory product specification for compostable plastics and PLA cutlery in India.

Compostable Polylactic Acid (PLA) Cutler.investigation_notes: Formulated jointly by PCD 12 and EED 1. Enforced by CPCB under Plastic Waste Management Rules.

new_standard.title: Methods for Measurement of Air Pollution: Part 2 Sulphur Dioxide
new_standard.scope: Prescribes methods of sampling and continuous instrumental analysis of ambient air pollution parameters (SO2, NOx, PM10, PM2.5, CO, Ozone, Ammonia, Benzene) in continuous ambient air quality monitoring stations (CAAQMS).
new_standard.materials: Temperature-controlled walk-in monitoring shelter, 19-inch rack-mounted continuous gas analyzers (UV fluorescence, chemiluminescence, NDIR, UV absorption), beta-attenuation monitor (BAM) for PM2.5/PM10.
new_standard.technical_requirements: National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) compliance limits (PM2.5 24h avg 60 ug/m3, PM10 100 ug/m3, SO2 80 ug/m3, NO2 80 ug/m3), analyzer linearity (R2 >= 0.99), span drift (max 1% per day), minimum data capture rate (min 85% uptime).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Real-time transmission of unmanipulated ambient air quality data directly to the CPCB / SPCB central environmental server for public National Air Quality Index (AQI) reporting.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Daily zero/span calibration per USEPA automated protocols, multi-point calibration per IS 5182, dynamic gas dilution calibration check.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / CPCB National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)

mapping.evidence_source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Guidelines for CAAQMS; Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1981
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory technical specifications for CAAQMS stations deployed under the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) across 131 non-attainment cities.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory environmental monitoring standard for CAAQMS stations in India.

Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitorin.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Regulated under CPCB NCAP guidelines.

new_standard.title: Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (CEMS) — Quality Assurance Requirements and Specifications
new_standard.scope: Specifies installation, calibration, quality assurance (QAL1, QAL2, QAL3) and data connectivity for online continuous emission monitoring systems installed on industrial chimney stacks.
new_standard.materials: In-situ or extractive gas sampling probe, heated sample line (180°C), sample gas conditioning chiller, multi-gas optical/infrared analyzer, stack particulate monitor (optical transmission / light scattering).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Stack emission measurement of particulate matter (PM), SO2, NOx, CO, CO2, and stack flow velocity; relative accuracy audit (RAA / RATA <= 10%), zero/span calibration drift (max 2% of span), data transmission latency to CPCB server (< 15 minutes).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Continuous online tracking of industrial stack emissions preventing unauthorized bypass of pollution control devices.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Cylinder gas audit (CGA), Relative Accuracy Test Audit (RATA) comparing CEMS data against manual reference isokinetic stack sampling per IS 11255.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / CPCB OCEMS Directives

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB Guidelines for Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (CEMS); Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 Section 5
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory directive under Section 5 EPA 1986: Compulsory installation of CEMS with 24x7 online data streaming to CPCB for 17 categories of highly polluting industries.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory industrial pollution monitoring standard for stack CEMS in India.

Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Mandatory statutory requirement under Section 5 EPA 1986.

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB CEMS Guidelines; Section 5 EPA 1986
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes quality assurance and specifications for continuous online stack emission monitors.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory specification for stack CEMS systems.

new_standard.title: Clarifiers for Water and Wastewater Treatment: Part 1 General Requirements and Mechanical Equipment
new_standard.scope: Specifies design, construction, and mechanical requirements for circular and rectangular clarifiers and dissolved air flotation (DAF) separators for industrial effluent treatment plants (ETP).
new_standard.materials: Carbon steel or epoxy-lined concrete flotation tank, micro-bubble air saturation pressure vessel (working pressure 0.4 to 0.6 MPa), surface skimmer scraper, bottom sludge auger.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Surface hydraulic loading rate (5 to 15 m3/m2/h), air-to-solids ratio (A/S 0.01 to 0.05), microbubble diameter (30 to 50 microns), total suspended solids (TSS) removal efficiency (min 85% to 95%), oil and grease removal efficiency (min 90% to 99%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Rapid flotation separation of emulsified oils, colloidal organics, and light solids in dairy, petroleum refinery, textile, and slaughterhouse wastewaters.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic tank leak test, skimmer mechanical drive torque test, turbidity and TSS reduction verification per IS 3025.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 Industrial Wastewater Committee

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB Comprehensive Industry Documents (COINDS) on ETP Design; BIS EED 1
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes mechanical and hydraulic design standards for clarification and flotation equipment in effluent treatment.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national engineering standard for industrial DAF clarifiers.

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB ETP Guidelines; BIS EED 1
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Specifies requirements for industrial effluent settling clarifiers and sludge scrapers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for industrial effluent clarifiers.

E-Waste Circuit Board Shredders.investigation_notes: Heavy industrial four-shaft and two-shaft shredders used for electronic waste printed circuit board (PCB) size reduction and precious metal recycling operate under authorization guidelines issued under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 administered by CPCB; however, no dedicated Indian Standard currently governs the mechanical manufacturing and shredding particle size specifications for electronic waste shredding machines.

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) Emission Standards for Thermal Power Plants (S.O. 3305(E)); CEA Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory installation of wet limestone / seawater FGD systems on all coal-fired thermal power plant units in India to achieve SO2 emissions < 100 mg/Nm3.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory air pollution control technology requirement for thermal power plants in India.

Flue Gas Desulphurization Systems.investigation_notes: Governed under MoEFCC thermal power plant environmental standards and monitored via CEMS.

new_standard.title: Reverse Osmosis and Membrane Water Purification Systems — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for hollow fiber ultrafiltration (UF) membrane modules (PVDF, PES, PAN polymers, pore size 0.01 to 0.05 microns) used for surface water treatment, wastewater reclamation, and RO pre-treatment.
new_standard.materials: Hydrophilic polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) or polyethersulfone (PES) hollow fibers potted in polyurethane inside uPVC casing.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Pure water flux (min 150 to 300 LMH/bar), bubble point integrity pressure (min 150 kPa), virus log reduction value (LRV >= 4 log), bacterial rejection (LRV >= 6 log), turbidity reduction (< 0.1 NTU), operating pH range (2 to 11 for chemical cleaning CIP).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Consistent silt density index SDI < 2.5 protecting downstream reverse osmosis membranes; high resistance to chlorine oxidation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Pressure decay bubble point test per ASTM D6908, microbial challenge test with MS2 bacteriophage, burst pressure test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 Water Treatment Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS EED 1 Sectional Committee Specifications; CPHEEO Water Treatment Manual
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes performance and integrity test standards for membrane filtration modules used in drinking water and wastewater reclamation.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for hollow fiber ultrafiltration membrane modules.

mapping.evidence_source: BIS EED 1 Sectional Committee Specifications; CPHEEO Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes salt rejection (min 99.5%) and permeate flux standards for industrial RO spiral-wound membrane elements.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for industrial reverse osmosis desalination membranes.

new_standard.title: Permissible Limits of Noise Level for Rotating Electrical Machines — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies acoustic enclosure sound attenuation and noise emission limits for diesel generator sets, air compressors, and industrial machinery.
new_standard.materials: CRCA sheet steel outer shell, rockwool / glasswool acoustic insulation slabs (density 64 to 96 kg/m3) protected by perforated GI sheet, acoustic splitter attenuator louvers.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Noise insertion loss (min 25 dBA sound attenuation at 1 metre distance per CPCB Environment Protection Rules), ventilation airflow CFM ensuring engine cooling without temperature rise exceeding 7°C above ambient.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Enables continuous 24x7 operation of heavy emergency diesel generator sets in residential, commercial, and hospital silent zones without noise violations.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Acoustic sound pressure survey at 1 m from enclosure boundary per CPCB test protocol, temperature rise test under 100% electrical load.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / CPCB Noise Regulations

mapping.evidence_source: Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986 (Schedule I Noise Limits for Diesel Generator Sets); CPCB Type Approval
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory statutory compliance: Every diesel generator set up to 1000 KVA manufactured or sold in India must be provided with an acoustic enclosure ensuring max 75 dBA at 1 metre.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory environmental standard for industrial acoustic sound attenuation canopies.

Industrial Acoustic Sound Attenuation En.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Mandatory compliance under Environment (Protection) Rules.

new_standard.title: Solid Waste Management — Code of Practice for Design and Operation of Waste Composting Systems
new_standard.scope: Specifies design, mechanical aeration, thermal monitoring and operation of aerobic mechanical composters, biodigesters, and in-vessel composting machines for solid organic waste.
new_standard.materials: Stainless steel 304 / heavy mild steel vessel, mechanical mixing auger, thermal heater, aeration blower, bio-filter for odour control.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Thermophilic composting temperature (55°C to 65°C maintained for min 3 consecutive days for complete pathogen kill), volume reduction (min 70% to 80% volume reduction within 24 to 48 hours), final compost C:N ratio (< 20:1), moisture content (15% to 25%), odour free operation.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Decentralized processing of segregated wet municipal solid waste at residential colonies, hotels, and IT parks without landfill dumping.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Compost maturity test (Solvita index / germination index > 80%), temperature profiling, heavy metals analysis per FCO 1985.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / Solid Waste Management Rules 2016

mapping.evidence_source: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016 (MoEFCC); Fertilizer (Control) Order, 1985 City Compost Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Bulk waste generators must segregate and compost biodegradable waste on-site conforming to SWM Rules 2016 and IS 15106.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory solid waste engineering standard for mechanical biodigesters and composters.

Mechanical Organic Waste Composting Biod.investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Regulated under Solid Waste Management Rules 2016.

mapping.evidence_source: Solid Waste Management Rules 2016; BIS EED 1
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes engineering and operational standards for automatic organic waste composting machines.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory specification for fully automatic organic waste composters.

mapping.evidence_source: CPCB Guidelines for Sewage Treatment Systems; BIS EED 1
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes biological carrier media surface area (min 500 to 1200 m2/m3) and fluidized bed hydraulics for MBBR packaged sewage plants.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national engineering standard for MBBR wastewater treatment systems.

mapping.evidence_source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Notification G.S.R. 1265(E); NGT Environmental Directives
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory discharge quality standards for all sewage treatment plants: pH 6.5-9.0, BOD <= 10 mg/L, TSS <= 20 mg/L, COD <= 50 mg/L, Fecal Coliform < 230 MPN/100ml.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory wastewater treatment standard for packaged sewage treatment plants in India.

Packaged Sewage Treatment Plants (STP).investigation_notes: Formulated by EED 1. Regulated under CPCB / NGT nationwide STP discharge standards.

new_standard.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater: Part 1 General Considerations
new_standard.scope: Specifies methods of sampling and physical/chemical probe measurement (pH, Dissolved Oxygen DO, Electrical Conductivity EC, Turbidity, ORP, Temperature) in surface and groundwater monitoring.
new_standard.materials: Multi-sensor probe body (titanium / 316L stainless steel), optical luminescent DO sensor, combined glass pH electrode, 4-electrode conductivity cell, nephelometric turbidity sensor.
new_standard.technical_requirements: pH range (0 to 14 +/- 0.1), DO range (0 to 20 mg/L +/- 0.1 mg/L optical sensor), conductivity range (0 to 100 mS/cm +/- 1%), turbidity (0 to 4000 NTU +/- 2%), submersible waterproof rating IP68 to 100 metres depth.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Continuous long-term in-situ limnological and river water quality monitoring without sensor drift.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Multipoint buffer calibration for pH, zero and 100% air calibration for DO, formazin standard calibration for turbidity per IS 3025.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 Water Quality Committee

mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes methods of sampling and instrument verification for multi-parameter water quality probes.

new_standard.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater: Part 39 Oil and Grease
new_standard.scope: Specifies methods of test and continuous online infrared / UV fluorescence monitoring for oil and grease in petroleum refinery and petrochemical effluent discharge.
new_standard.materials: Non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) or UV fluorescence optical analyzer with automatic ultrasonic solvent extraction module.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Measuring range (0 to 100 mg/L oil in water), detection limit (0.1 mg/L), accuracy (+/- 2% of full scale), response time (< 5 minutes), automatic zero calibration.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Instant alarm triggering upon oil surge prevent accidental maritime or river pollution.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Calibration check with certified hexadecane/isooctane standards per Annex B, comparative partition-gravimetric test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards EED 1 / CPCB Guidelines
